// Shared native-account and B20 engine for Base docs demos.
//
// Mintlify snippets cannot import modules. A snippet fetches this file and aa.txt,
// rewrites the relative AA specifier to aa.txt's Blob URL, evaluates this module
// with a <script type="module"> tag, and reads the published API from window.

import {
  canonicalAuthenticators,
  createPublicClient,
  decodeAbiParameters,
  encodeAbiParameters,
  encodeFunctionData,
  encodeWalletCalls,
  estimateGas,
  generatePrivateKey,
  getTransactionCount,
  http,
  key,
  keccak256,
  newSmartAccount,
  privateKeyToAccount,
  toHex,
  waitForTransactionReceipt,
} from "./aa.txt";

export const ACTIVATION_REGISTRY = "0x8453000000000000000000000000000000000001";
export const POLICY_REGISTRY = "0x8453000000000000000000000000000000000002";

export const STABLECOIN_FEATURE = "0xecfa0def2c10020caaf65e6155aa69c84b24892aaef76eeac52e0e2b3a0b8601";

export const TOKEN_DECIMALS = 6;

const MIN_GAS_BALANCE = 5_000_000_000_000_000n; // 0.005 ETH
const DEFAULT_MAX_FEE = 1_000_000_000n;
const DEFAULT_PRIORITY_FEE = 1_000_000n;
const ZERO_MEMO = `0x${"0".repeat(64)}`;

  TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY: keccak256(toHex("TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY")),
  MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY: keccak256(toHex("MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY")),
};

  "0xb9b2a425": "FeatureNotActivated",
  "0x4b344b11": "SupplyCapExceeded",
  "0xa43fec12": "PolicyForbids",
  "0xfd8c4245": "ContractPaused",
  "0xf9df5ac9": "ContractPaused",
  "0x64a5cb46": "AccountNotBlocked",
  "0xe2517d3f": "AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount",
  "0x30b1b565": "InsufficientBalance",
  "0x8e4a23d6": "Unauthorized",
};

  {
    type: "function",
    name: "isActivated",
    stateMutability: "view",
    inputs: [{ type: "bytes32" }],
    outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
  },
];

    outputs: [{ type: "address" }],

  {
    type: "function",
    name: "createB20",
    stateMutability: "payable",
    inputs: [{ type: "uint8" }, { type: "bytes32" }, { type: "bytes" }, { type: "bytes[]" }],
    outputs: [{ type: "address" }],
  },
  {
    type: "function",
    name: "isB20Initialized",
    stateMutability: "view",
    inputs: [{ type: "address" }],
    outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
  },
];

const client = createPublicClient({
  chain: {
    id: CHAIN_ID,
    name: NETWORK_NAME,
    nativeCurrency: { name: "Ether", symbol: "ETH", decimals: 18 },
    rpcUrls: { default: { http: [ACCOUNT_RPC] } },
  },
  transport: http(ACCOUNT_RPC),
});

let inTabLock = Promise.resolve();
let memoryStoredAccount = null;

async function fetchWithTimeout(url, options = {}, timeoutMs = 10_000) {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...options, signal: controller.signal });
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timeout);
  }
}

async function rpc(method, params = []) {
  const response = await fetchWithTimeout(ACCOUNT_RPC, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: Date.now(), method, params }),
  });
  const body = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!response.ok || body?.error) {
    const error = new Error(body?.error?.message ?? `${method} returned ${response.status}`);
    error.code = body?.error?.code;
    error.data = body?.error?.data;
    throw error;
  }
  return body.result;
}

async function post(path, body) {
  const response = await fetchWithTimeout(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const parsed = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(parsed?.error ?? `${path} returned ${response.status}`);
  return parsed;
}

async function withAccountLock(fn) {
  if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.locks?.request) {
    return navigator.locks.request("base-docs-vibenet-account", { mode: "exclusive" }, fn);
  }
  const previous = inTabLock;
  let release;
  inTabLock = new Promise((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
  await previous;
  try {
    return await fn();
  } finally {
    release();
  }
}

function randomHex(bytes) {
  const buffer = new Uint8Array(bytes);
  crypto.getRandomValues(buffer);
  return `0x${Array.from(buffer, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")}`;
}

export function randomAddress() {
  return randomHex(20);
}

export function explorerTx(hash) {
  return `${EXPLORER_URL}/tx/${hash}`;
}

export function explorerAddress(address) {
  return `${EXPLORER_URL}/address/${address}`;
}

export function units(value) {
  return BigInt(value) * 10n ** BigInt(TOKEN_DECIMALS);
}

export function displayUnits(value) {
  const raw = BigInt(value);
  const scale = 10n ** BigInt(TOKEN_DECIMALS);
  const whole = raw / scale;
  const fraction = (raw % scale).toString().padStart(TOKEN_DECIMALS, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
  return Number(fraction ? `${whole}.${fraction}` : whole.toString());
}

export function memoToBytes32(value) {
  if (/^0x[\da-fA-F]{64}$/.test(value)) return value;
  const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(value);
  if (encoded.length > 32) throw new Error("Memo text must be 32 UTF-8 bytes or fewer.");
  return `0x${Array.from(encoded, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")}${"0".repeat((32 - encoded.length) * 2)}`;
}

export function bytes32ToMemo(value) {
  const bytes = [];
  for (let index = 2; index < value.length; index += 2) {
    const byte = Number.parseInt(value.slice(index, index + 2), 16);
    if (byte === 0) break;
    bytes.push(byte);
  }
  return new TextDecoder().decode(new Uint8Array(bytes));
}

function roleId(name) {
  return keccak256(toHex(name));
}

function scopeId(name) {
  const value = POLICY_SCOPES[name];
  if (!value) throw new Error(`Unsupported policy scope: ${name}`);
  return value;
}

function functionItem(abi, name) {
  const item = abi.find((entry) => entry.type === "function" && entry.name === name);
  if (!item) throw new Error(`Unknown function ${name}`);
  return item;
}

async function readFunction(address, abi, functionName, args = []) {
  const item = functionItem(abi, functionName);
  const data = encodeFunctionData({ abi, functionName, args });
  const raw = await rpc("eth_call", [{ to: address, data }, "latest"]);
  const decoded = decodeAbiParameters(item.outputs ?? [], raw);
  return decoded.length === 1 ? decoded[0] : decoded;
}

export async function genesisHash() {
  const block = await rpc("eth_getBlockByNumber", ["0x0", false]);
  if (!block?.hash) throw new Error("Vibenet returned no genesis block hash");
  return block.hash;
}

export async function contracts() {
  const response = await fetchWithTimeout(`${API_URL}/api/vibenet/contracts`, { cache: "no-store" });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Contract lookup failed (${response.status})`);
  return response.json();
}

export async function probeCapabilities(domain = "stablecoin") {
  const [chainId, blockNumber, asset, stablecoin, policy] = await Promise.all([
    rpc("eth_chainId"),
    rpc("eth_blockNumber"),
    readFunction(ACTIVATION_REGISTRY, activationAbi, "isActivated", [ASSET_FEATURE]),
    readFunction(ACTIVATION_REGISTRY, activationAbi, "isActivated", [STABLECOIN_FEATURE]),
    readFunction(ACTIVATION_REGISTRY, activationAbi, "isActivated", [POLICY_FEATURE]),
  ]);
  const expectedChain = BigInt(chainId) === BigInt(CHAIN_ID);
  const domainActive = domain === "asset" ? asset : stablecoin;
  return {
    live: expectedChain && domainActive && policy,
    chainId: Number(BigInt(chainId)),
    blockNumber: Number(BigInt(blockNumber)),
    capabilities: { asset: Boolean(asset), stablecoin: Boolean(stablecoin), policy: Boolean(policy) },
    reason: !expectedChain
      ? `Unexpected chain ${Number(BigInt(chainId))}`
      : !domainActive
        ? `B20 ${domain} creation is not activated`
        : !policy
          ? "B20 policy writes are not activated"
          : null,
  };
}

function loadStoredAccount() {
  if (memoryStoredAccount) return memoryStoredAccount;
  if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") return null;
  try {
    memoryStoredAccount = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ACCOUNT_STORAGE_KEY) || "null");
    return memoryStoredAccount;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function saveStoredAccount(value) {
  memoryStoredAccount = value;
  if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(ACCOUNT_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch {
    // Private browsing or an unavailable storage quota: keep the account for
    // this page session in memory and continue.
  }
}

export async function getSharedAccount() {
  const [deployment, genesis] = await Promise.all([contracts(), genesisHash()]);
  const implementation = deployment.eip8130?.DefaultAccount;
  if (!implementation) throw new Error("Vibenet reported no DefaultAccount implementation");

  let stored = loadStoredAccount();
  if (
    !stored ||
    stored.version !== 1 ||
    stored.genesisHash !== genesis ||
    stored.implementation?.toLowerCase() !== implementation.toLowerCase()
  ) {
    stored = {
      version: 1,
      genesisHash: genesis,
      implementation,
      privateKey: generatePrivateKey(),
      salt: randomHex(32),
    };
  }

  const signer = privateKeyToAccount(stored.privateKey);
  const account = newSmartAccount({ signer, implementation, salt: stored.salt });
  if (stored.address && stored.address.toLowerCase() !== account.address.toLowerCase()) {
    stored.privateKey = generatePrivateKey();
    stored.salt = randomHex(32);
    const nextSigner = privateKeyToAccount(stored.privateKey);
    const nextAccount = newSmartAccount({ signer: nextSigner, implementation, salt: stored.salt });
    stored.address = nextAccount.address;
    saveStoredAccount(stored);
    return { account: nextAccount, signer: nextSigner, genesisHash: genesis, implementation };
  }
  stored.address = account.address;
  saveStoredAccount(stored);
  return { account, signer, genesisHash: genesis, implementation };
}

export async function isDeployed(address) {
  const code = await rpc("eth_getCode", [address, "latest"]);
  return Boolean(code && code !== "0x");
}

async function ensureFunded(address) {
  const balance = BigInt(await rpc("eth_getBalance", [address, "latest"]));
  if (balance >= MIN_GAS_BALANCE) return null;
  const drip = await post("/api/vibenet/faucet/drip", { address });
  await waitForTransactionReceipt(client, { hash: drip.tx_hash, timeout: 60_000 });
  return drip.tx_hash;
}

async function highestNonce(address) {
  let highest = 0n;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt += 1) {
    const value = await getTransactionCount(client, { address, nonceKey: 0n });
    if (value > highest) highest = value;
    if (attempt < 2) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 120));
  }
  return highest;
}

function structuralGas({ deployed, calls }) {
  const base = 45_000n;
  const deploy = deployed ? 0n : 160_000n;
  const perCall = 22_000n * BigInt(Math.max(calls, 1));
  const batch = calls > 1 ? 9_000n : 0n;
  return 2n * (base + deploy + perCall + batch);
}

async function waitUntilDeployed(address) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 12; attempt += 1) {
    if (await isDeployed(address)) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
  }
}

export async function sendCalls({ calls, metadata = "", gasFloor = 0n }) {
  if (!calls?.length) throw new Error("No calls to send");
  return withAccountLock(async () => {
    const { account, signer } = await getSharedAccount();
    const faucetHash = await ensureFunded(account.address);
    const deployed = await isDeployed(account.address);
    const accountChanges = deployed ? [] : [account.createChange];
    const nonceSequence = await highestNonce(account.address);
    const phases = [calls.map((call) => ({ to: call.to, value: call.value ?? 0n, data: call.data ?? "0x" }))];
    const floor = [structuralGas({ deployed, calls: calls.length }), BigInt(gasFloor)].reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
    let gas = floor;

    if (deployed) {
      try {
        const estimated = await estimateGas(client, {
          sender: account.address,
          senderActorId: key.k1(signer.address).actorId,
          senderAuthAuthenticator: canonicalAuthenticators.k1,
          accountChanges,
          calls: phases,
          nonceSequence: Number(nonceSequence),
        });
        const buffered = BigInt(estimated) * 13n / 10n;
        if (buffered > gas) gas = buffered;
      } catch {
        // Expected for calls intentionally demonstrating an on-chain rejection.
        // Normal write paths still use the conservative structural floor.
      }
    }

    const serialized = await account.signTransaction({
      chainId: CHAIN_ID,
      accountChanges,
      calls: encodeWalletCalls({ account: account.address, calls: phases }),
      metadata: metadata ? toHex(metadata) : undefined,
      nonceKey: 0n,
      nonceSequence,
      maxFeePerGas: DEFAULT_MAX_FEE,
      maxPriorityFeePerGas: DEFAULT_PRIORITY_FEE,
      gas,
    });
    const hash = await rpc("eth_sendRawTransaction", [serialized]);
    const receipt = await waitForTransactionReceipt(client, { hash, timeout: 60_000 });
    if (receipt.status === "0x0") throw Object.assign(new Error(`Transaction reverted (${hash})`), { hash, receipt });
    const phasesStatus = receipt.eip8130?.phaseStatuses ?? receipt.phaseStatuses ?? [];
    const failedPhase = phasesStatus.findIndex((status) => status === "0x0");
    if (failedPhase !== -1) {
      throw Object.assign(new Error(`Phase ${failedPhase} reverted (${hash})`), { hash, receipt });
    }
    if (!deployed) await waitUntilDeployed(account.address);
    return { hash, receipt, faucetHash, account: account.address, deployedByThisTx: !deployed };
  });
}

function encodeB20(functionName, args = []) {
  return encodeFunctionData({ abi: b20Abi, functionName, args });
}

function encodePolicy(functionName, args = []) {
  return encodeFunctionData({ abi: policyRegistryAbi, functionName, args });
}

export async function createStablecoin({
  name = "Docs Demo USD",
  symbol = "aUSD",
  currency = "USD",
  initialMint,
  mintTo,
  supplyCap,
  policies = [],
} = {}) {
  const { account } = await getSharedAccount();
  const salt = keccak256(toHex(`${name}:${symbol}:${Date.now()}:${randomHex(8)}`));
  const params = encodeAbiParameters(
    [{ type: "tuple", components: [{ type: "uint8" }, { type: "string" }, { type: "string" }, { type: "address" }, { type: "string" }] }],
    [[1, name, symbol, account.address, currency]],
  );
  const token = await readFunction(B20_FACTORY, factoryAbi, "getB20Address", [1, account.address, salt]);
  const initCalls = ROLE_NAMES.map((role) => encodeB20("grantRole", [roleId(role), account.address]));
  if (supplyCap !== undefined) initCalls.push(encodeB20("updateSupplyCap", [BigInt(supplyCap)]));
  for (const policy of policies) initCalls.push(encodeB20("updatePolicy", [scopeId(policy.scope), BigInt(policy.id)]));
  if (initialMint !== undefined) {
    initCalls.push(encodeB20("mintWithMemo", [mintTo ?? account.address, BigInt(initialMint), memoToBytes32("docs-demo-setup")]));
  }
  const createData = encodeFunctionData({ abi: factoryAbi, functionName: "createB20", args: [1, salt, params, initCalls] });
  const tx = await sendCalls({
    calls: [{ to: B20_FACTORY, data: createData }],
    metadata: `Create ${symbol}`,
    gasFloor: 2_000_000n,
  });
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 12; attempt += 1) {
    if (await readFunction(B20_FACTORY, factoryAbi, "isB20Initialized", [token])) break;
    if (attempt === 11) throw new Error("The B20 transaction landed, but the token is not initialized yet");
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
  }
  return { token, ...tx };
}

export async function createAsset({
  name = "Docs Demo Asset",
  symbol = "EXM",
  decimals = TOKEN_DECIMALS,
  roles = ASSET_ROLE_NAMES,
  initialMints = [],
  supplyCap,
  policies = [],
} = {}) {
  const { account } = await getSharedAccount();
  const salt = keccak256(toHex(`${name}:${symbol}:${Date.now()}:${randomHex(8)}`));
  const params = encodeAbiParameters(
    [{ type: "tuple", components: [{ type: "uint8" }, { type: "string" }, { type: "string" }, { type: "address" }, { type: "uint8" }] }],
    [[1, name, symbol, account.address, decimals]],
  );
  const token = await readFunction(B20_FACTORY, factoryAbi, "getB20Address", [0, account.address, salt]);
  const initCalls = roles.map((role) => encodeB20("grantRole", [roleId(role), account.address]));
  if (supplyCap !== undefined) initCalls.push(encodeB20("updateSupplyCap", [BigInt(supplyCap)]));
  for (const policy of policies) initCalls.push(encodeB20("updatePolicy", [scopeId(policy.scope), BigInt(policy.id)]));
  if (initialMints.length) {
    initCalls.push(encodeFunctionData({
      abi: assetAbi,
      functionName: "batchMint",
      args: [initialMints.map((mint) => mint.to), initialMints.map((mint) => BigInt(mint.amount))],
    }));
  }
  const createData = encodeFunctionData({ abi: factoryAbi, functionName: "createB20", args: [0, salt, params, initCalls] });
  const tx = await sendCalls({
    calls: [{ to: B20_FACTORY, data: createData }],
    metadata: `Create ${symbol}`,
    gasFloor: 2_000_000n,
  });
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 12; attempt += 1) {
    if (await readFunction(B20_FACTORY, factoryAbi, "isB20Initialized", [token])) break;
    if (attempt === 11) throw new Error("The B20 transaction landed, but the asset is not initialized yet");
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
  }
  return { token, ...tx };
}

export async function configureAssetControls({ token, roles = [], supplyCap }) {
  const { account } = await getSharedAccount();
  const calls = roles.map((role) => ({ to: token, data: encodeB20("grantRole", [roleId(role), account.address]) }));
  if (supplyCap !== undefined) calls.push({ to: token, data: encodeB20("updateSupplyCap", [BigInt(supplyCap)]) });
  return sendCalls({ calls, metadata: "Configure asset controls" });
}

export async function updateAssetMetadata({ token, key, value }) {
  const data = encodeFunctionData({ abi: assetAbi, functionName: "updateExtraMetadata", args: [key, value] });
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: `Update asset metadata: ${key}` });
}

export async function batchMint({ token, recipients, amounts }) {
  const data = encodeFunctionData({
    abi: assetAbi,
    functionName: "batchMint",
    args: [recipients, amounts.map((amount) => BigInt(amount))],
  });
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: "Batch issue asset units" });
}

export async function announceDistribution({ token, recipients, amounts, id, description, uri }) {
  const batch = encodeFunctionData({
    abi: assetAbi,
    functionName: "batchMint",
    args: [recipients, amounts.map((amount) => BigInt(amount))],
  });
  const data = encodeFunctionData({
    abi: assetAbi,
    functionName: "announce",
    args: [[batch], id, description, uri],
  });
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: "Announce asset distribution" });
}

export async function isAnnouncementIdUsed(token, id) {
  return readFunction(token, assetAbi, "isAnnouncementIdUsed", [id]);
}

export async function updateMultiplier({ token, multiplier }) {
  const data = encodeFunctionData({ abi: assetAbi, functionName: "updateMultiplier", args: [BigInt(multiplier)] });
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: "Update asset multiplier" });
}

export async function assetMultiplier(token) {
  return readFunction(token, assetAbi, "multiplier");
}

export async function scaledBalanceOf(token, address) {
  return readFunction(token, assetAbi, "scaledBalanceOf", [address]);
}

export async function assetMetadata(token, key) {
  return readFunction(token, assetAbi, "extraMetadata", [key]);
}

export async function assetDetails(token) {
  const [name, decimals, totalSupply, supplyCap, multiplier] = await Promise.all([
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "name"),
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "decimals"),
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "totalSupply"),
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "supplyCap"),
    readFunction(token, assetAbi, "multiplier"),
  ]);
  return { name, decimals: Number(decimals), totalSupply, supplyCap, multiplier };
}

export async function createPolicy({ kind, accounts = [] }) {
  const { account } = await getSharedAccount();
  const policyType = kind === "allowlist" ? 1 : 0;
  const data = encodePolicy("createPolicyWithAccounts", [account.address, policyType, accounts]);
  const tx = await sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: POLICY_REGISTRY, data }], metadata: `Create ${kind} policy` });
  const topic = keccak256(toHex("PolicyCreated(uint64,address,uint8)"));
  const log = tx.receipt.logs.find((entry) => entry.address?.toLowerCase() === POLICY_REGISTRY.toLowerCase() && entry.topics?.[0]?.toLowerCase() === topic.toLowerCase());
  if (!log?.topics?.[1]) throw new Error("PolicyCreated was missing from the receipt");
  return { id: BigInt(log.topics[1]), ...tx };
}

export async function attachPolicy({ token, scope, id }) {
  const data = encodeB20("updatePolicy", [scopeId(scope), BigInt(id)]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: `Attach ${scope}` });
}

export async function updateAllowlist({ id, allowed, accounts }) {
  const data = encodePolicy("updateAllowlist", [BigInt(id), Boolean(allowed), accounts]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: POLICY_REGISTRY, data }], metadata: allowed ? "Add allowlist members" : "Remove allowlist members" });
}

export async function updateBlocklist({ id, blocked, accounts }) {
  const data = encodePolicy("updateBlocklist", [BigInt(id), Boolean(blocked), accounts]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: POLICY_REGISTRY, data }], metadata: blocked ? "Block accounts" : "Unblock accounts" });
}

export async function mint({ token, to, amount, memo }) {
  const data = memo === undefined
    ? encodeB20("mint", [to, BigInt(amount)])
    : encodeB20("mintWithMemo", [to, BigInt(amount), memoToBytes32(memo)]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: "Mint stablecoin" });
}

export async function burn({ token, amount, memo }) {
  const data = memo === undefined
    ? encodeB20("burn", [BigInt(amount)])
    : encodeB20("burnWithMemo", [BigInt(amount), memoToBytes32(memo)]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: "Burn stablecoin" });
}

export async function burnBlocked({ token, from, amount }) {
  const data = encodeB20("burnBlocked", [from, BigInt(amount)]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: "Recover blocked stablecoin" });
}

export async function setSupplyCap({ token, amount }) {
  const data = encodeB20("updateSupplyCap", [BigInt(amount)]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: "Update stablecoin supply cap" });
}

export async function transfer({ token, to, amount, memo }) {
  const data = memo === undefined
    ? encodeB20("transfer", [to, BigInt(amount)])
    : encodeB20("transferWithMemo", [to, BigInt(amount), memoToBytes32(memo)]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: memo === undefined ? "Transfer stablecoin" : "Transfer stablecoin with memo" });
}

export async function setTransfersPaused({ token, paused }) {
  const data = encodeB20(paused ? "pause" : "unpause", [[0]]);
  return sendCalls({ calls: [{ to: token, data }], metadata: paused ? "Pause transfers" : "Resume transfers" });
}

export async function balanceOf(token, address) {
  return readFunction(token, b20Abi, "balanceOf", [address]);
}

export async function tokenDetails(token) {
  const [name, currency, decimals, totalSupply, supplyCap] = await Promise.all([
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "name"),
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "currency"),
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "decimals"),
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "totalSupply"),
    readFunction(token, b20Abi, "supplyCap"),
  ]);
  return { name, currency, decimals: Number(decimals), totalSupply, supplyCap };
}

export async function isAuthorized(id, address) {
  return readFunction(POLICY_REGISTRY, policyRegistryAbi, "isAuthorized", [BigInt(id), address]);
}

export async function isTransferPaused(token) {
  return readFunction(token, b20Abi, "isPaused", [0]);
}

function findRevertData(error) {
  const candidates = [error?.data, error?.cause?.data, error?.details, error?.message];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (typeof candidate === "string") {
      const match = candidate.match(/0x[\da-fA-F]{8,}/);
      if (match) return match[0];
    }
    if (candidate && typeof candidate === "object") {
      const nested = findRevertData(candidate);
      if (nested) return nested;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function decodeRevert(error) {
  const data = findRevertData(error);
  const selector = data?.slice(0, 10)?.toLowerCase();
  return { name: ERROR_NAMES[selector] ?? "ExecutionReverted", selector, data };
}

export async function expectRevert({ from, token, functionName, args, expected }) {
  const data = encodeB20(functionName, args);
  try {
    await rpc("eth_call", [{ from, to: token, data }, "latest"]);
  } catch (error) {
    const decoded = decodeRevert(error);
    if (expected && decoded.name !== expected) {
      throw new Error(`Expected ${expected}, received ${decoded.name}`);
    }
    return decoded;
  }
  throw new Error(`Expected ${expected ?? "the call"} to revert, but it succeeded`);
}

export function readMemoFromReceipt(receipt) {
  const memoTopic = keccak256(toHex("Memo(address,bytes32)"));
  const log = receipt.logs.find((entry) => entry.topics?.[0]?.toLowerCase() === memoTopic.toLowerCase());
  // Both Memo fields are indexed: topics[1] is caller and topics[2] is memo.
  const raw = log?.topics?.[2];
  if (!raw || raw.length !== 66) throw new Error("Memo was missing from the receipt");
  return { raw, text: bytes32ToMemo(raw), logIndex: Number(BigInt(log.logIndex)) };
}
